definition: Consolidate functioning into established, readily accessible capacities that can serve as resources or become limiting through overreliance.
functionalAim: Provide stable, accumulated competence that supports efficient functioning while remaining available for integration with emerging capacities.

distinctions.north_node: Develops complementary capacity; South Node consolidates existing capacity.
distinctions.saturn: Saturn structures systems; South Node reflects accumulated functioning.
distinctions.chiron: Chiron adapts; South Node provides established resources.

constraints: Must always be interpreted with the North Node.
Consolidation may become overreliance only with contextual evidence.
Established capacity is not automatically limiting.
